title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): AL developers can use semantic search on data and metadata
summary: AL developers in Business Central 2026 release wave 1 can use semantic ranking to search both data and metadata with similarity-based queries through the new Semantic Data Search codeunit. The feature is currently restricted to on-premises environments only.
key_points: New codeunit 2000000025 enables semantic search on metadata objects and data records with similarity ranking
Developers can query records using similarity-based syntax like TOP n by similarity to search terms
Methods include SetMaxResults, SetSearchTarget, and FindSimilarByField for controlling searches
Currently scoped to OnPrem only, unavailable for cloud extensions due to scope restrictions

quotes.text: The Scope attribute is currently set to OnPrem. This means it cannot be used in the cloud version.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical limitation explaining why the feature is unavailable for cloud extension development
